text:
maria: FYI — partner uploaded a new checkpoint bundle (opal-4b-distilled). Can we run our standard due-diligence before any hosting/benchmarking?
aj_legal: Thanks — what license does the bundle claim? link? any additional clauses?
maria: repo link here: https://git.example.com/opal/opal-4b-distilled (manifest included). I skimmed: mentions Apache-2.0 but also has a supplementary file called HOSTING_RESTRICTIONS.md, need legal eyes.
leo: I kicked off a quick eval on our internal bench: native FP16 -> PPL 12.8, distilled seems competitive. INT8 quant (offline): ~+1.7% perplexity and a small drop on the domain QA set. Not yet pushed to repro artifacts.
compliance-bot: automated-scan: license fields inconsistent. manifest.license = "Apache-2.0"; HOSTING_RESTRICTIONS.md contains a clause: "No commercial hosting or serving of weights without explicit partner consent." Flag: RESTRICTED_HOSTING.
aj_legal: That's an actionable blocker for Hosted API. If the clause forbids commercial hosting, we cannot expose it on hosted tier without a contract amendment. Dedicated/Private might be allowed depending on wording (non-distribution vs non-hosting). I'll parse the exact clause.
rami: Also need to check export-control and provenance. Do we know training infra origin or whether any US tech restrictions apply? Partner says training logs redacted.
maria: Open items I propose: 1) legal: confirm impact of HOSTING clause (aj_legal) 2) provenance: confirm training infra & any restricted datasets (leo + partner) 3) quant QA: full INT8/FP16 eval on our benchmark + safety/regression tests (leo) 4) hosting plan: if clause blocks hosted, map to Dedicated/Private options and required contract language (rami + aj_legal) 5) metadata: missing model card fields (dataset list, tokenizer license, training dates) (maria)
aj_legal: Agreed. Quick checklist I'll run through: - quote exact clause and identify whether it's a redistribution or hosting prohibition; - check attribution/notice obligations (Apache requires preserving notices); - check derivative-works language (are converted/quantized weights derivatives?); - advise on an interim mitigation (private-hosting only until redline).
leo: For quant experiments I'll containerize the run and push logs to ci-artifacts. Example command to reproduce the license-check + eval starter: ```bash
# license check + minimal eval
curl -s https://git.example.com/opal/opal-4b-distilled/manifest.json | jq .license
python eval/run_bench.py --model-path ./opal-4b-distilled --dtype int8 --tasks qa,conv_safety --out results/opal-int8.json
```
maria: Noted. If legal says we can only host for non-commercial research, we should prepare a gating label in the model catalog ("hosting: restricted") and ensure routing policy avoids hosted tier.
aj_legal: Also — look for any clauses about attribution or trademark. If they require a specific banner or forbids certain downstream commercial features, we'll need product/legal signoff.
rami: Operational question: if partner permits private/dedicated only, do we need to change our deployment packaging (we currently create a hosted container image that we deploy to shared infra)? We should be able to create a non-hosted deployment artifact and mark it private-only. I'll draft deployment constraints.
leo: Early eval notes: small hallucination regression on the finance prompts. I'll add a targeted prompt set and a quality gating threshold. If quantization pushes regression >2% on held prompts we shouldn't promote.
maria: Partner contact is emma@partner.ai — I'll loop them in and ask for origin-of-training infra and any export-control paperwork. Can someone on legal/infra own outreach?
aj_legal: I'll take partner outreach for contract language. Assign to me: get a redline and clarify hosting clause. ETA: EOD +1.
rami: I'll own the infra constraints and deployment artifact changes. ETA: 2 business days for a draft.
leo: I'll run full quant + safety suite, push results to ci and link in thread. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
compliance-bot: note: created ticket M-2247 (model-legal-due-diligence) and attached manifest snapshot.
maria: Great. If legal says "no hosted" we need to mark the model with catalog tag: `hosting:restricted`, add `legal:needs-redline`, `provenance:pending`. I'll update the intake sheet. :white_check_mark:
aj_legal: One more thing — check if model license allows us to redistribute converted weights (quantized). Some licenses permit redistribution of source weights only. If redistribution forbidden, even sharing INT8 artifacts internally across customers could be a violation.
leo: Noted. I'll keep quant artifacts isolated to our internal eval buckets until we get an OK.
maria: OK, will update intake and set the onboarding priority to "blocked: legal" until aj_legal confirms. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
